GSPR.description: General Spring (GSPR). Assigns previously defined general spring types (TYPE_NAME) to a node key; each entry in ITEMS links the node to a general spring type and an optional boundary group.

ITEMS.description: List of general spring assignments for this node. Each element references a defined general spring type by name and, optionally, a boundary group name.

ID.description: Serial number identifying this assignment within the node key. When 0 (default) the key is resolved/created automatically from the node and group.

GROUP_NAME.description: Name of an existing boundary group to associate. Empty string (default) means no group. Must match a defined boundary group name; otherwise the request is rejected.

TYPE_NAME.description: Name of a previously defined general spring type (GSTP). Must match an existing general spring type name; otherwise the request is rejected.
